title: When a tool and the operator's intent conflict, the intent wins
situation: Learned on 2026-10-14 adopting the workflow on an existing project with delivered work and an earlier design record. A tool's requirement made an architect put a lead's report inside the repository and read it, against the operator's instruction that it go elsewhere, unread.
decision: Where a tool's constraint conflicts with what the operator asked for, the operator's intent wins: the agent does what was asked by another means or raises the conflict to the operator, and never lets the tool quietly override the instruction. The conflict is also a defect in the tool.
consequences: The architect's stance and the lead's carry this.
